basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original opaque full-bleed 5:7 portrait oil painting for a medieval dark-fantasy civilization Practice card. Seek the storytelling compositional mastery of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action, bold silhouettes, monumental environmental scale, broad expressive visible oil brushwork, large calm color masses, and the sharpest contrast only at the action. Early twentieth-century adventure book painting, not photorealistic or glossy digital fantasy. Include two or three human figures; all faces completely indiscernible, shown from behind, distant, masked by helmets, or in deep shadow. Put the action, key tool or material, and principal figures in the UPPER CENTRAL 45 percent because game UI covers the lower half. The lower half is subdued and quiet. Clear at 70x100 pixels. No text, letters, symbols, decorative border, frame, interface, vignette, tiny clutter, or unrelated objects. Subject:

assets.siegecraft: Three tiny helmeted engineers release a colossal wooden trebuchet at the instant its long arm whips upward. The pale sling and great diagonal arm are focal against a storm sky; distant fortress a small dark shape. Machine dwarfs people, broad quiet ground.
assets.fletching: In a tall dim workshop, three hooded fletchers attach large pale feathers to a row of wooden arrows. The foremost hands press one bright white feather to the shaft in upper center; high racks of arrows simplify to dark vertical lines. Ivory accent against umber.
assets.bannerMaking: Three faceless cloth workers stretch and sew one great plain crimson military banner inside an immense timber hall. The red cloth hangs as a single bold focal plane, one worker lifting its corner while others guide it. No emblem, heraldry, or writing.
assets.drilling: Before a vast fortress wall, three clear helmeted soldiers lead rows of distant tiny trainees in synchronized spear drill. At one frozen instant the three front spears angle together toward a pale sky, a clean repeated diagonal. No faces, no insignia, broad grey wall and ground.
assets.warriorTraining: In a large stone training yard, two helmeted trainees spar with broad wooden practice swords while a third cloaked instructor watches from behind. The crossed pale wooden swords and balanced lunging silhouettes are the focus. High battlement walls show scale, quiet earth below.
assets.recruiting: Beneath a monumental city gate, one cloaked officer clasps forearms with a new helmeted recruit while a second recruit waits with a plain pack. The joined arms are the warm-lit focal gesture; huge dark gate and distant queue make them small. Faces hidden.
assets.mountedDrill: Three helmeted riders practice a tight coordinated turn around one pale stone marker in a vast empty parade field. Lead horse and tilted lance make a decisive silhouette against broad sky; distant fortress wall and hills establish scale. No battle or faces.
assets.skirmishingDrill: Three small helmeted warriors move between widely spaced standing stones in a huge training field, one releasing a short javelin toward a plain circular target. The javelin's bright line and target are focal, strong diagonals and empty space; no combat injury.
assets.raidingParties: Three hooded raiders creep over a low ridge toward a far settlement at dusk; the leader raises one small torch and points to a gap in the palisade. Torch flame and pointing arm are focal, vast dark valley and distant huts make the band tiny. No faces or gore.
assets.requisitioning: At a settlement granary beneath towering walls, three helmeted quartermasters lift one heavy pale grain sack from the threshold onto a waiting cart. The shared burden and taut arms are focal against dark stone; villagers remain distant shadows, no violence.
assets.tributeTaking: On the steps of an immense stone hall, a small hooded envoy hands a single iron-bound chest to two helmeted figures. The exchange at the high doorway catches warm light; architecture dwarfs everyone. Clear offering gesture, subdued blue-grey stone, no faces.
assets.spoilsSorting: Beneath a huge dark military tent, three helmeted figures sort a pile of captured gear into separate crates. One raises a bright plain steel helmet into a shaft of light while the others carry sacks and shields. The lifted helmet is sole focal silver accent, no gore.
